text:
inc-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — NLB euc3: elevated 5xx and connection resets detected. Triggered at 2026-03-15T14:02:00Z. Pager: sam (oncall). Affected infra: NLB -> Envoy ingress -> backend pools in euc3a/euc3b. Symptoms: client TCP RSTs and 502/504 surge.

sam (oncall): acked. I'm on it, will post updates here. Paging netops.

maya: I see the spike in LB metrics — 5xx rate jumped to ~27% across euc3 at 14:03 UTC. Backend target health shows intermittent Unhealthy for multiple targets in euc3b.

liam: copying logs from envoy on one failing pod:```[2026-03-15T14:03:12Z] envoy upstream reset, connection error: connection reset by peer (errno=104)
[2026-03-15T14:03:15Z] upstream response timeout after 10s
```Looks like upstream connectivity to instances is flapping, likely at AZ network or host level.

netops-bot: AWS health: euc3b reported elevated network error rates in this window. No public AWS outage, likely an AZ-level network degradation. Telemetry: increased route churn in euc3b ToR switches.

taylor: quick mitigation plan: 1) shift Route53 traffic weight off euc3 to euc2/euc1 (temporary). 2) increase NLB connection tracking timeout / connection retries. 3) enable fallback route in frontend (force prefer-region header). I'll coordinate Route53 change now.

sam (oncall): please run the Route53 weight change and post the change-id. Also update status page.

taylor: running change:```aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z3EXAMPLE --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.ai","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"euc2","Weight":70,"AliasTarget":{"HostedZoneId":"ZLB","DNSName":"nlb-euc2.example.amazonaws.com."}} ,{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.ai","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"euc3","Weight":10,"AliasTarget":{"HostedZoneId":"ZLB","DNSName":"nlb-euc3.example.amazonaws.com."}}]}}'``` ChangeId: C1234567890-xyz.

support: status page updated: "Partial outage in euc3 affecting API requests; mitigation in progress; working on failover."

liam: after DNS weight shift we see 5xx drop in euc3 from 27% -> 4% within 3 minutes. Client error volume normalizing. Confirming no data loss but increased latency for some traffic.

maya: double-checking internal metrics — connection resets in euc3b pods reduced after steering. Remaining errors localized to a small set of hosts; I'll mark those instances out of rotation and spin replacements.

netops-bot: automated host replacement triggered for 5 instances in euc3b (replaced by ASG). Network team is continuing root cause triage for AZ fabric.

sam (oncall): good. Handing off monitoring and follow-up to liam for post-incident cleanup and RCA. I'll stay available for escalation.

liam: taking over for follow-up. Action items: collect pcap/logs from euc3b hosts, preserve NLB metrics, review ToR switch logs with network team, and draft postmortem. ETA for initial RCA: EOD.

sre-lead: thanks team. Severity: Sev2 (partial region outage impacting some customers). Assigning postmortem owner: liam. Please include timeline, customer impact estimate (requests affected, error budget consumption), and mitigation runbook updates (DNS failover checklist + oncall playbook updates).

support: customers alerted via ticketing where we saw elevated errors; we've queued a follow-up message once RCA is available.

sam (oncall): closing page for now — system health stable region-wide after weighting. Anyone observing regressions ping me.

inc-bot: Incident resolved (status: mitigated) — root cause investigation ongoing.

liam: final note — preserved logs/pcaps uploaded to /incidents/2002503456/artifacts. Will share RCA draft by EOD and schedule a postmortem meeting tomorrow.
